Alma 24:7–9 identifies this as the king’s speech; calling him only an unnamed male speaker is conservative but leaves the established speaker unidentified. The dialogue excerpts are verbatim and do not invent speech.
Alma 24:10–11 continues the king’s address, but the character is labeled only “Speaker.” The dialogue excerpts are verbatim and do not invent speech.
